title: Dijkstra's Shortest Paths
summary: Find the cheapest total weight from a start vertex to every other vertex in a graph with positive edge weights. Each round settles the closest unsettled vertex and relaxes its edges.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Weighted edges
inputs.hint: Edges as triples: vertex, vertex, weight. For example 0, 1, 4, 1, 2, 3 means 0–1 (weight 4) and 1–2 (weight 3).

inputs.name: vertices
inputs.label: Number of vertices
inputs.hint: From 1 to 8. Vertices are numbered 0 up to one less than this number.

inputs.name: start
inputs.label: Start vertex
inputs.hint: Where the search begins: a vertex number from 0 up to vertices − 1.

anchors.label: Store the weighted edges in a matrix
Distances start at infinity; the start is 0
Settle it: its distance is final
